trigger.before: The earlier one-shot and shard attempts used duplicated request/response handling and safely retained no raw response shape.
trigger.after: This execution uses only repodelta.llm.openai.complete_json_object for DeepSeek JSON-mode request construction, response normalization, and safe failure classification.

known_reasoning_dependencies: The verifier shares the DeepSeek provider with the deepseek-v4-flash proposer.
It also shares the deepseek-v4-pro model identifier with the earlier AI adjudicator, while using a fresh execution and a separately authored lifecycle prompt.
This establishes procedural separation, not independent error modes or semantic correctness.

model_input_exclusions.adjudication_ledger: The committed adjudication ledger remains provenance evidence for later lifecycle review but is excluded from this source-evidence model input to avoid agreement pressure and unnecessary context expansion.

review_contract.direct_rows: Every semantic-direct proposal label is independently reviewed against source evidence.
review_contract.non_direct_rows: Every non-direct proposal label is independently reviewed under the frozen full-population plan.
review_contract.acceptance: Only 54 accepted, schema-valid decisions with accept_empty out-of-universe review permit the later protocol verification check.
review_contract.failure_behavior: Any provider failure, missing reported model identity, malformed or incomplete output, candidate mismatch, challenge, prohibited-surface access, or unmet protocol diversity condition leaves the proposal unverified and emits no semantic metric.

stop_condition: This plan permits exactly one lifecycle execution. Any failed or challenged result is committed as bounded evidence; no second execution design or retry is authorized by this plan.

runner.contract: The runner verifies every frozen input digest, invokes only the canonical adapter, requires the provider-reported model identity, validates the full lifecycle output before writing it, and persists no raw provider response or error text.

authority_boundary: This execution reviews a proposed evaluation reference. It cannot itself verify that reference, produce semantic FI/FE, change production association, or alter formal assessment.
